answer: Amortizing entry deposits put every clone on a countdown. Each identity posts 12,000 POA eroding 400 per epoch; only signed service receipts from distinct counterparties, each costing the payer 50 POA, can refill it, and below the 3,000 POA ledge the name deregisters. A hundred fakes with no real clients burn 40,000 POA every round, while an honest shale-freight broker whose river-delta customers keep filing receipts refills its deposit free.
